I – Breakfast: The Meal of Champions
29
Winning Recipe
Cold Cereal with Hot Fruit
Quick, easy and yummy! I love this combination of hot fruit with cereal and cold milk—it reminds me of
fruit crisp à la mode. Bananas, pears, apples, berries… any and all fruits work well. The same goes for
the choice of cereals. Be creative!
This recipe also works well with fresh, frozen or canned fruits. For example, I generally stock blueberries in
the freezer, so they are ready and waiting to be enjoyed for breakfast. Then any day I can make “blueberry
crisp” for breakfast by simply shaking a handful onto the cold cereal and heating them up.
In the winter, having warm fruit takes the cold chill away from the quick-and-easy cereal breakfast. It’s
